COORDINATE

Body corporate remediation.
One coordinated scope.

Committees and building managers need a scope they can understand and work they can track. We investigate, scope and coordinate remedial waterproofing and related trades, with project records for the building.

THE SCOPE

A system, step by step.

The written scope establishes what your particular building needs.

  1. 01

    Investigate the defects

    Establish the cause and the areas that need attention.

  2. 02

    Prepare the scope

    Set out the proposed system, trades and access in writing.

  3. 03

    Coordinate the crew

    Bring the relevant remedial trades under one point of contact.

  4. 04

    Hand over the records

    Provide photo evidence, QA records and the project handover pack.

A FEW PRACTICAL ANSWERS

Before you
get started.

All common questions
What types of buildings do you work on?

Apartment and unit complexes, townhouse complexes, commercial buildings and mixed-use buildings.

What size of work is a good fit?

We focus on larger remedial scopes, with typical projects of $10,000–$100,000+. Small handyman work and one-off patch jobs are outside that focus.
